ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.08:0.92 ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black/dark-grey) pixels across the visible fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Predominantly low-intensity dark field with distinct high-contrast white contiguous blobs localized at the distal tips of both lobes and sparse, scattered white punctate spots (3-10 pixels) across the central ventral region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 102 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge with high-frequency serrations; peak-to-valley pixel amplitudes range from 2 to 15 pixels across the continuous boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Upward concave curvature extending from the median notch to the outer distal tips of the fluke lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density cluster of high-contrast white pixels on the left lobe tip; multiple discrete circular white clusters (rosettes) distributed across the medial and lateral regions of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular structural morphology and jagged tissue loss on the distal edge of the left lobe tip, accompanied by dense white scarring.
other_distinctive_markers: Consistent high-intensity white 'frosting' along the uppermost ridges of the trailing edge serrations.
